name: Takamine Kaori
source:
Yuuto's younger stepsister, whose parents died in an airplane crash. A bright and good-natured girl, she is taken hostage by the king of Rakios in order to force Yuuto to fight against his will. Harbors secret feelings for Yuuto.
[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/aselia/chara.html]jastusa.com[/url]]
